title: Loc By-Contributors Output Matches Spec
description: Align `loc --by-contributors` text/markdown with spec: (1) contributor and history tables with zero tree LOC omit useless loc and tree-% columns, show wip% + churn sorted by edited; (2) history with --by-contributors carries only the commit author's cumulative row per step; (3) omit redundant inner contributor label when it matches the commit author alone.
summary: Contributor-only tables (Total.loc == 0) now use churn layout: Category | wip% | edited | added | removed, sorted by edited with Total last (locSortedRowKeysChurn). Full snapshot/history merged tables still show loc + tree % when Total.loc > 0 (locUseFullTreeTable). With --history --by-contributors, each history entry's ByContributors map contains only the commit author's cumulative snapshot, removing duplicate per-commit blocks for every contributor. Markdown/text skip the redundant inner contributor line when there is a single row and its key matches entry.Author.
